name: ChatGPT
capability: Draft, analyse files and create work you can review.
access: Start with a browser account; file and calculation tools depend on mode and plan.
fit: You need help across writing, files and analysis, and already use ChatGPT.
firstStep: Try one client reply using approved notes and check every commitment.
limit: A helpful draft still needs a reviewer; connected actions depend on the tools you have enabled.

name: Claude
capability: Draft documents and analyse uploaded files; create editable outputs.
access: Browser account; check file creation and usage limits in your plan.
fit: Your work often starts with long notes or documents and ends in an editable file.
firstStep: Give it an approved brief and ask for a short document plus a list of missing facts.
limit: Open and inspect the finished file; confident wording does not establish accuracy.

name: Gemini
capability: Work with uploaded documents and spreadsheets.
access: Google account; Workspace permissions and upload limits vary.
fit: You want to discuss supplied files or work within an existing Google environment.
firstStep: Supply one current document and ask for its key actions with supporting passages.
limit: Confirm access to the specific Workspace feature; a Google account alone does not guarantee every integration.

name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
capability: Draft and revise work in the Microsoft 365 environment.
access: Check the specific app, work account licence and administrator settings.
fit: Your team already works in Outlook and Microsoft 365 with an eligible account.
firstStep: Draft a reply using an approved email thread, then review it before sending.
limit: Check the specific app and licence; do not assume it can see every team document.

name: Notion AI
capability: Write, search workspace knowledge and turn notes into tasks.
access: Best evaluated inside an existing Notion workspace; full AI access depends on plan.
fit: Procedures and team notes already live in a maintained Notion workspace.
firstStep: Turn one current procedure into a checklist and have its owner check it.
limit: Outdated source pages produce outdated guidance; keep a person responsible for them.

name: NotebookLM
capability: Ask questions of selected sources and inspect supporting citations.
access: Google account; currently labelled Gemini Notebook on the presenting account.
fit: You need to ask questions of a defined source collection and inspect citations.
firstStep: Upload one current RFQ, ask for requirements and open the deadline citation.
limit: Check the original passage and selected sources; a saved answer is not automatically current.
keywords: notebook lm google notebook gemini notebook

name: Adobe Acrobat AI
capability: Ask about PDFs and follow citations back to source passages.
access: Check AI Assistant/PDF Spaces entitlement; OCR quality affects scanned documents.
fit: Most of the source material you work with is PDF and Acrobat is already part of the workflow.
firstStep: Ask a question about one PDF and inspect the cited passage.
limit: Scans and complex tables can be misread; verify original values and page context.

name: Excel Copilot
capability: Explore spreadsheet data, formulas, summaries and visualisations in Excel.
access: Requires an eligible account and supported workbook setup; check Excel requirements.
fit: The working workbook already lives in an eligible Excel setup.
firstStep: Ask about one clean table and check a formula and total yourself.
limit: Data structure, account access and workbook support affect what is available.

name: Julius
capability: Analyse spreadsheet data and turn findings into reports.
access: Account and usage allowance required; verify calculations against your source file.
fit: You want a dedicated workspace for exploring a supplied dataset.
firstStep: Upload a small dated table and request a chart with its calculation explained.
limit: Reconcile the underlying numbers; an attractive chart does not validate the source data.

name: Codex
capability: Build small tools, edit files and run checks in an authorised workspace.
access: Prepare a demo folder and tool access first; review files and test results.
fit: You need working files and checks for a calculator, form or internal tool.
firstStep: Describe exact rules and known answers; ask it to build and test the actual file.
limit: Publishing and ongoing maintenance still need an owner; review access before connecting business data.

name: Claude Code
capability: Read a project, change files and run development commands.
access: Coding workspace setup and an eligible subscription/API account; technical review needed.
fit: Someone can prepare and review an existing coding workspace.
firstStep: Ask for one small change with acceptance checks in an authorised project.
limit: Technical review is needed for commands, code changes and production access.

name: Cursor
capability: Build and revise code with an agent inside an editor.
access: Install an editor and prepare the project; review commands and changes.
fit: A person maintains your software in a code editor.
firstStep: Try a small, reviewable change and run the project’s checks.
limit: It is an editor workflow; plan for someone who can review and maintain the result.

name: Replit
capability: Build and preview apps from a brief in a browser workspace.
access: Check build credits and hosting costs separately; test before publishing.
fit: You want a browser workspace to build and preview an initial app.
firstStep: Build a simple form using sample data and check the result on a phone.
limit: A working preview is only a start; check hosting, permissions and ongoing costs before launch.

name: Lovable
capability: Create and iterate on web apps from a natural-language brief.
access: Check credits, hosting and backend requirements; review access and data handling.
fit: You need to explore a web app idea through a prompt-driven prototype.
firstStep: Describe one user journey and test the preview before adding more features.
limit: Review stored data, access and hosting before using it with real customers.

name: Make
capability: Connect apps and branch a repeatable workflow in a visual builder.
access: Connect authorised accounts; budget for automation credits and any AI provider usage.
fit: You want to see branching steps and app connections on a visual canvas.
firstStep: Connect one internal trigger and action, then test a missing field and duplicate.
limit: Account connections and error handling need setup; AI steps can add separate usage costs.

name: Zapier
capability: Run actions in connected apps when a trigger occurs.
access: Account connections and a tested trigger/action setup; features and task limits vary.
fit: You have a clear trigger and action supported by the apps you already use.
firstStep: Create one tested record or internal notification before adding more steps.
limit: Task limits, app support and multi-step features depend on the plan.

name: n8n
capability: Build flexible workflows with AI steps and human fallbacks.
access: More technical setup; cloud subscription or maintained self-hosting plus provider costs.
fit: You need flexible workflow logic and have technical help to maintain it.
firstStep: Build a small internal flow with a failure route to a person.
limit: Self-hosting brings maintenance work; it is not simply a free replacement for a managed service.

name: Canva
capability: Turn a brief into designs, images and social content you can edit.
access: Check AI feature limits and asset licences for the account you use.
fit: You need editable social visuals or presentations and want direct layout control.
firstStep: Use an approved caption and actual product photo to create one phone-readable post.
limit: Check asset rights, factual claims and the final export; AI features vary by account.

name: Gamma
capability: Turn a brief or source material into a presentation draft.
access: Check creation credits, export options and plan limits.
fit: You need a first presentation draft from structured notes.
firstStep: Give it six approved points and one clear ask; review the slide sequence.
limit: Check exported slides and source evidence; generated slides can still contain unsupported claims.

name: Descript
capability: Edit recorded video through its transcript and create captions or clips.
access: Prepare a recording you may use; check media minutes and AI credits.
fit: You have a recording and want to edit it through its transcript.
firstStep: Make one short clip, then compare the cut and captions with the original.
limit: Transcript errors and tight cuts can change meaning; review the finished media.

name: Otter
capability: Transcribe meetings and extract summaries and action items.
access: Obtain participant agreement before recording; check language support and meeting limits.
fit: You need meeting transcription and action summaries with participants’ agreement.
firstStep: Capture one agreed meeting and confirm the summary with its participants.
limit: Check exact language support and speaker attribution before relying on the transcript.

name: DeepL
capability: Translate supported languages and documents with consistent glossary terms.
access: Confirm your exact language pair and glossary/file features before subscribing.
fit: It supports your exact language pair and terminology needs.
firstStep: Translate one approved message and have a fluent reviewer check it.
limit: Do not assume every language or glossary feature is available on every plan.

name: Intercom Fin
capability: Answer support questions from approved knowledge and route exceptions to people.
access: Needs maintained support content, escalation rules and a costed support setup.
fit: You have maintained support content and enough enquiries to justify a connected support setup.
firstStep: Test a small FAQ set and an unanswered question before considering customer-facing use.
limit: Content maintenance, handoffs and ongoing conversation costs need an owner.
keywords: intercom fin chatbot helpdesk customer service

name: Perplexity
capability: Research the web with linked sources.
access: Check source dates and original pages; deeper research allowances vary by plan.
fit: You need to discover sources and build an initial web comparison.
firstStep: Compare three options and open the original sources for the key claims.
limit: Source links are a starting point; verify dates, quoted terms and supplier details.

name: Buffer
capability: Draft and adapt social copy, then organise posts for supported channels.
access: Connect the correct social accounts. Check supported formats, channel limits and team approval features for your plan.
fit: Approved posts need a reliable calendar across supported social accounts.
firstStep: Save one post as a draft, preview the channel and deliberately approve its schedule.
limit: Check post format and time zone; connected scheduling can publish without a later confirmation.
keywords: buffer social media calendar schedule publishing

name: Mailchimp
capability: Create email content from approved material inside a campaign builder.
access: AI email content creation requires a paid plan and the supported email builder. Audience setup and approval to send are separate.
fit: You have a maintained subscriber audience and a recurring email campaign.
firstStep: Build one draft from an approved offer and send a test to yourself.
limit: An AI draft does not establish permission to email the audience or prove the offer is accurate.
keywords: mail chimp newsletter subscribers email campaign

name: HubSpot
capability: Use customer records to prepare for sales meetings and draft follow-ups.
access: Keep customer records current. AI meeting and follow-up features depend on the HubSpot product, account permissions and plan.
fit: A team needs shared lead history, ownership and follow-up context.
firstStep: Use one current deal record to prepare a follow-up draft and review the proposed next step.
limit: Missing or stale CRM data weakens the draft; verify the record before updating or sending.
keywords: hub spot crm breeze sales leads pipeline
